overview: Hollywood Scandals formally known as Fame and Scandal, is about the good and bad of some of the most well known celebrities of all-time.
title: Hollywood Scandals

overview: As Canções da Minha Vida is a great mosaic of Brazilian music. Through interviews and musical performances we learn the most striking songs that influenced the Brazilian songbook. A great homage to the Brazilian music made by its protagonists.
title: As Canções da Minha Vida

overview: A secret project in Korea is exposed to the U.S. The U.S. demands the termination of the project, but a delivery accident occurs during the NIS's attempt to hand over the sample. Paul, a U.S. Agent, harshly pressures the NIS after the incident and confronts the leader of the project, Director Choe. Meanwhile, Jagyeong, a key character in this case, and Lim Sang, a retired veteran, begin chasing Director Choe's subordinate, Moyong, for different reasons. Everyone gathers in the end, and an unexpected turn of events takes place as ownership of the last sample is at stake.
title: The Tyrant

overview: Dr. Jack Graham's mission is to glorify God by introducing Jesus Christ as Lord to as many people as possible and to develop them in Christian living using the most effective means to impact the world, making an eternal difference in this generation.
title: PowerPoint with Jack Graham

overview: The BBC's Katty Kay sits down for in-depth conversations with some of the most powerful and change making people in the worlds of culture, business and science. From world renowned chefs and dancers, to the people redefining the way we think about medicine, business strategy and literature, Katty's informal, unscripted interviews reveal the people behind the personas that are inspiring the world today.
title: Influential with Katty Kay

overview: Political leaders are quizzed by Christopher Hope with analysis from Patrick Christys and political guests.
title: Vote 2024: The Leaders

overview: As the polls close, Krishnan Guru-Murthy and Emily Maitlis presents news and analysis as the votes are counted, while ex-Labour strategist Alastair Campbell and former Conservative MP Rory Stewart steer viewers through what many are predicting to be a game-changing moment in British politics. Cathy Newman anchors from locations across London and reporters attend key counts across the country, while political editor Gary Gibbon offers continuous analysis. Mathematics professor Hannah Fry crunches the data at the big screen, helping to make sense of the numbers and tell the story of the night. Going beyond Westminster, Gogglebox favourites provide their take on the election campaigns, while an audience of voters give their take as the night unfolds.
title: Britain Decides with The Rest Is Politics and Gogglebox

overview: In Mafia Spies viewers discover real-world spies, gangsters, honeypots and mistresses that unravels a hidden conspiracy between the CIA and the Chicago mob to assassinate Fidel Castro at a critical time in the Cold War; President Kennedy made it known that there was no living with Castro with missiles 90 miles from American soil.
title: Mafia Spies

overview: 1st Look is the Emmy-winning, lifestyle show that takes you to the country's hottest destinations for amazing eats, thrilling adventures and crazy fun nightlife. Each week, join Johnny Bananas as he takes you along for the ride!
title: 1st Look

overview: A confident, independent woman, meets a straightforward, loyal yet untamed younger man. Their journey of mutual healing and redemption unfolds into a love story that is both irresistibly sweet and deeply intense, filled with a captivating sense of destiny.
title: Sniper Butterfly

overview: Outrageous Love with NeNe Leakes captures the trials, triumphs, and tribulations of real couples. The new series showcases wild clips of real people caught up in love as NeNe reacts and gives her personal insight alongside the action.
title: Outrageous Love with NeNe Leakes

overview: Parents Gone Wild depicts parenthood in all its messy glory - it can be exhausting, rewarding, exasperating, and laugh-out-loud funny. These raw, real, and relatable moments are captured by the moms, dads and even kids in their own personal videos, providing an intimate glimpse into the world of parenting like never before.
title: Parents Gone Wild

overview: Hosted by Tony Armstrong with Catherine Murphy, Monday's Experts is a new sports entertainment show covering all that happens both on and off the field each week, joined by a panel of sports journalists and comedians.
title: Monday's Experts

overview: Australia was once home to a group of extraordinary animals known as Megafauna. What became of them has been debated for over a century, but now a team of scientists are re-opening this paleolithic cold case.
title: Megafauna: What Killed Australia's Giants?

overview: Rose and Lana are sisters, both married and living next door to each other in Lankworthy Road, Muswell Hill - a London suburb. Gerald Garvey is an underpaid, middle-class executive who has a snobbish attitude, but he and Rose don't have the income to back it up. Harry Butt, on the other hand, is an affluent, working-class fitter, and he and Lana never miss the chance to show off their luxury goods and lifestyle in front of their poorer relatives.
title: Beggar My Neighbour

overview: Children's drama series about a London-based cycle courier company.
title: Streetwise

overview: A senior high school student dreams of becoming a Greco-Roman wrestling champion, but his strict father forces him to give up the sport for a career as a doctor. The main character faces a choice: to fulfill his dream or his father's dream.
title: 60 кг

overview: Modeled after the longtime, highly regarded BBC show of the same name, Premier League Match of the Day presents an extended highlights rundown -- all of it by way of the original announcer calls from the game broadcasts -- of every Premiere League match from Saturday, plus post-match interviews and reactions. Rebecca Lowe, who covered soccer for the BBC and ESPN prior to joining NBC Sports, hosts the show, with analysis presented by former Jamaican national team player Robbie Earle and former English footballer Robbie Mustoe, and contributions by legendary U.K. striker Gary Lineker and Daily Mail columnist Neil Ashton.
title: Premier League Match of the Day

overview: Narrated by Ashley Walters, BMX All Stars follows young riders from one of the most successful clubs in the UK, Peckham BMX. The ten-episode series, packed full with adrenaline-fuelled, BMX racing, also features Olympians Kye Whyte, Beth Shriever, Quillan Isidore and freestyler Charlotte Worthington, as well as pro rider Tian Isidore and freestyler James Jones.
title: BMX All Stars

overview: Join Kris Smith as he explores the diverse world of Australian tradesmen, highlighting the crucial roles they play in construction, plumbing, farming, carpentry, and more.
title: Business Drive

overview: The Maine Cabin Masters have set out to test their skills in a whole new country -- Italy! Chase, Sarah and the kids head to a remote village to renovate their own dream home and along the way, they get a little help from their friends!
title: Maine Cabin Masters: Building Italy

overview: Breaking news, developing stories and live events from Sky News correspondents in the UK and around the world.
title: Sky News Today with Matt Barbet

overview: Breaking news, developing stories and live events from Sky News correspondents in the UK and around the world.
title: Sky News Today with Saima Mohsin

overview: Jonathan Samuels presents a round-up of the day's main news stories with reports and analysis from our correspondents in the UK and around the world.
title: Sky News at 5pm

overview: A summary of the latest news headlines.
title: Sky News at 8pm

overview: A summary of the latest news headlines.
title: Sky News at 9pm

overview: A round-up of the latest home and international news, sporting headlines and weather summaries.
title: Sky News at 11

overview: With a plot elaborated over time, this story about the forbidden love of Leonor and Eduardo in the 17th century had a tragic ending as she was sentenced to death for witchcraft. However, the mysterious fate brought them together several centuries later as Diana and Mario. This time, she is a doctor and he is a renowned scientist. Will they succumb to an inexplicable attraction and open their arms to eternal love 400 years later?
title: El extraño retorno de Diana Salazar

overview: Jayne Secker presents the latest breaking news, reports and analysis from the Sky News team across the UK and around the world.
title: Sky News Today

overview: A new series of live recorded comedy specials, including stand-up, improv, and solo performances!
title: Dropout Presents

overview: Munroe Bergdorf and Tayce meet up with British LGBTQ+ celebrities to discuss the pop culture moments that influenced their queer identities, their "queerpiphanies". Guests also plan a fictional party in honour of these moment.
title: Queerpiphany

overview: Abigail Dalton the recently elected British Prime Minister is fighting for office thanks to a healthcare crisis. Vivienne Toussaint is the first female French President campaigning for re-election no matter what — including tackling France's borders. A summit between the two women could be the answer to their prayers if they can agree. But when Dalton's husband is kidnapped and Toussaint is blackmailed, they both face unimaginable choices. Forced into a fierce rivalry where their political futures, and lives, might hang in the balance, can they work together to uncover the plot that threatens them both?
title: Hostage

overview: Life in Cold Blood is a study of the evolution and habits of amphibians and reptiles, it is the sixth and last of Attenborough's specialised surveys following his major trilogy that began with Life on Earth.
title: Life in Cold Blood

overview: When the war ends in 1945, the Allies and Soviets sweep across former Nazi territory, freeing Europe from the evil clutches of the Axis. And as the threat of the Nazis recedes, it leaves behind strange artefacts of a dark science geared towards world domination, morbid experiments in biology and genetic engineering, weapons to unleash chaos, world firsts and bests, all geared towards fomenting Nazi supremacy. How was science being mobilized for dark purposes? What secret Nazi science remains to be uncovered?
title: Secret Nazi Science

overview: The Food Blogger's Journey: Exploring Shaanxi Flavors The food blogger, Shi Guang, along with the manager Ji Yu, embarked on a culinary adventure through Shaanxi on a variety show. Through discovering local delicacies, they uncovered heartwarming stories that revealed new perspectives on life and personal growth.
title: Love's Little Delicacies

overview: Pulling with My Parents follows young singletons from across the country who are stuck in a merry-go-round of bad dates and dating apps. Jaded with swiping left or right, ghosting and disastrous dates, these singletons are taking drastic action and handing over the reins to their parents to give their dating profiles a full make-over to crack the cupid conundrum.
title: Pulling with My Parents

overview: Jayne Secker presents a comprehensive round-up of all the key stories of the day so far, with all the latest breaking news, live events and reports and analysis from Sky News correspondents around the world.
title: Sky News at One

overview: Part comedy, part social commentary, host Jesus Trejo embarks on a journey across America meeting with six rising comedians who explore the mosaic of our nation through the lens of stand-up comedy.
title: Roots of Comedy with Jesus Trejo

overview: Breaking news, developing stories and live events from Sky News correspondents in the UK and around the world.
title: Sky News Today with Kamali Melbourne

overview: Join Mark Austin for a comprehensive take on the big stories of the day with reports and analysis from Sky News correspondents around the world.
title: The News Hour with Mark Austin

overview: For young adults, summer is a time of reinvention, romance, rivalries and friendships. Families come to Lake Eleanor to escape their daily lives back home; but will they only find more drama?
title: The Lake

overview: Madison is about a group of teenagers in high school. The show deals with their everyday problems and concerns. We see the kids grow from high school students to fully grown adults.
title: Madison

overview: Nora, Audie, and Lily are three sisters navigating life events. Lily is newly single, Audie worried about her real estate career while Nora is a successful accountant happily married to Howie.
title: Sibs

overview: The story of Cris Miró, the first successful Argentine trans star, an icon of the 90s and a revolutionary whose legacy still lives on.
title: Cris Miró (Ella)

overview: A chronicle of the most consequential events of 1989.
title: 1989: The Year That Made Us

overview: Teeming with marine wildlife, our oceans are full of fascinating stories – like that of the sperm whale, the biggest predator on earth, that lives in the Mediterranean alongside the elusive monk seal. Underwater filmmaker Thomas Behrend takes us to the habitat of the ocean sunfish with the help of a high-tech submarine camera. And while giant octopuses and manatees are the heroes of another story, a marine biologist tells us about her unique friendship with a dolphin on the Irish coast.
title: Geheimnisse der Meere

overview: Ryotaro is a cheerful professional soccer player devoted to the game he loves. He has risen to national team member, and come through with decisive goals when it counts… until injury begins to plague him. Facing retirement at 37, he realizes it is a little late for him to enter normal working society. Enter a sports management company called "Victory" which offers him a new lease on life. Yet somewhere in his heart, Ryotaro has not quite accepted his retirement, and he will need to reconcile with new challenges as an old rookie.
title: The Old Dog, New Tricks?

overview: Laura Diamond is a brilliant NYPD homicide detective who balances her "Columbo" day job with a crazy family life that includes two unruly twin boys and a soon-to-be ex-husband - also a cop - who just can't seem to sign the divorce papers. Between cleaning up after her boys and cleaning up the streets, she'd be the first to admit she has her "hot mess" moments in this hilariously authentic look at what it really means to be a working mom today. Somehow, she makes it all work with the help of her sexy and understanding partner, and things becomes even more complicated when her husband becomes her boss at the precinct. For Laura, every day is a high-wire balancing act.
title: The Mysteries of Laura

overview: Flashpoint is a drama which depicts the emotional journey into the tough, risk-filled lives of a group of cops in the SRU (inspired by Toronto's Emergency Task Force). It's a unique unit that rescues hostages, busts gangs, defuses bombs, climbs the sides of buildings and talks down suicidal teens. Members of a highly-skilled tactical team, they're also trained in negotiating, profiling and getting inside the suspect's head to diffuse the situation to try and save lives.
title: Flashpoint

overview: Live from the heart of Hollywood, five young and diverse hosts break down the latest in entertainment, pop culture, and celebrity news in a fast-paced, hour-long daily show. Exclusive in-studio interviews, real-time social media interaction and a unique voice you won't get anywhere else, Hollywood Today LIVE is THE can't-miss show where anything can happen… and usually does.
title: Hollywood Today Live

overview: Tanya brings up two children alone during the day, and works in a taxi at night. Everything changes when she finds out about a serious diagnosis. Now she is worried about only one thing: who will the children stay with if the disease turns out to be stronger? Tanya is not ready to entrust them to unreliable relatives and decides to find a decent man, marry him to herself, so that if anything happens, he will take care of the children. The only person Tanya shares her thoughts with is her doctor. Suddenly, the plan works, and at some point there are too many applicants.
title: Между нами химия

overview: Italy is not without reason one of the world's most popular holiday destinations. Yet its fascinating wildlife remains largely unknown: wolves and brown bears in the forests of Northern Italy, flamingos in the Po delta and dolphins off the coast of Sicily. Stunning time-lapse and slow-motion footage show the country's flora and fauna in a completely new light and landscapes unfold impressively in majestic aerial photography. This two-part documentary sets itself apart from others of its kind, with spectacular pictures capturing the unique light and atmosphere of Italy.
title: Wildes Italien

overview: Stories of aqua farmers and fishermen striving for a sustainable future for the globe. Innovative solutions and ground-breaking blue food technology to save fresh waterways in addition to providing food for human consumption.
title: Hope in the Water

overview: Proof pairs two unlikely heroes together – disgruntled FBI Agent-in-Training Ginger Rodriguez and John "Proof" Prufrock, a jazz-loving Bigfoot – to protect the world from Cryptids: obscure creatures whose existence has yet to be proven. While these two start out as a surprising duo, they strike up an unlikely friendship, partnership, and even potential romance as they help save the world side by side.
title: Proof

overview: The heroes fight in the seemingly idyllic setting of the Karkonosze Mountains, against which the international drug trade takes place. Who will support the nameless avenger and who will stand behind the demonic boss of the local mafia? It's only a seemingly simple matter.
title: Prosta sprawa

overview: A dog has been man's best friend for several thousand years. It is not known exactly where and when people domesticated the dog. Most likely, this happened in southern Africa, where the oldest breed of dog, the Africanis, still lives. Probably no one knows the exact number of dog breeds in the world. More than 450 of them are officially registered. The host of the "Planet of Dogs" program, Grigory Manev, went on a trip around the world to different countries and continents to understand how and why chow-chows and chihuahuas, lapdogs and shepherd dogs, setters and spaniels, mastiffs and retrievers. Amazing canine geography: from China, Malta and France to Spain, Holland, Russia and South Africa. Grigory meets dogs everywhere and every time he is convinced that dogs and owners are very similar to each other, no matter where they live.
title: Планета собак

overview: It's no secret that people make mistakes. Every person involved in the production of a film can also make a mistake. The screenwriter will add a dubious fact to the plot; the cameraman will not notice the dangling microphone in the frame. Between shots, the actor suddenly changed his clothes - thanks to the editor and continuity. How many of these errors fit in one film? One or two? Oh if only! Especially for you, the creators of KinoFail took a closer look at the smallest details in the frame, and prepared video reports on blunders in well-known films.
title: КиноFail

overview: The mystical series "Kill the Snake" is based on the book by Valery Vainin in the fantasy genre. The forces of Darkness represented by the Snake clan oppose the forces of Light represented by the Mongoose clan. The serpent must build a pyramid, at the head of which he will be able to control humanity. At the base of the pyramid, he gathers talented and influential people, politicians, bandits. Mongoose's task is to figure out the Snake and defeat him before he manages to complete the pyramid. This has happened many times in the history of mankind, and now the Serpent is building his pyramid in the 21st century in Moscow. The mongoose, under the guise of school French teacher Gleb, begins to look for him in order to fight. His friends help him in his search.
title: Убить змея

overview: Managing a chaotic emergency room in the toughest and most overcrowded hospital in Berlin is no small task for the young Dr. Parker, who is seeking a fresh start in the big city after her private life implodes in Munich. When she tries to implement necessary reforms, Parker is confronted with resistance from the underpaid, ill-equipped and chronically fatigued hospital staff who only survive with an indispensable dose of black humor. But in the face of an increasingly merciless healthcare system, the battered team must put aside their differences and pull together to save lives.
title: KRANK Berlin

overview: Associate Professor Stehlík transfers from the police academy to the homicide department due to a near-administrative error. He joins the team right after the detectives begin investigating the brutal murder of a young woman in a forest near Prague.
title: Docent

overview: The definitive story of Dr Ruja Ignatova, the founder of a multi-billion-dollar cryptocurrency company called OneCoin who suddenly disappeared, leaving millions of people high and dry in her wake.
title: Kill Bitcoin!

overview: Modern forensic science student Tang Bing'er unexpectedly finds herself in the body of Qin Xiyue, the notorious concubine of the Heng Kingdom. Using her forensic knowledge, she unravels mysteries, solves numerous strange cases, and joins forces with Crown Prince Ling Xuan. Together, they bring stability to the Heng Kingdom and protect its people
title: Princess Across Time

overview: After her father's death in battle and a mysterious warning from her injured brother, Chu Yu vows to uncover the truth. She marries into the defeated Wei family as her late brother's widow to investigate, where she meets the sole survivor, Wei Yun. Though initially guarded, Wei Yun grows fond of Chu Yu, and mutual feelings emerge. Despite the obstacle of their "in-law" relationship, they face dangers together, uncover secrets, and protect their homeland side by side.
title: Fight for Love

overview: The story uses a time-displaced character relationship to help solve a case spanning 25 years. It blends crime suspense with warmth. Through a series of cases triggered by a building fire in the 1990s, it tells the story of Hong Kong police pursuing justice and family bonds, while showcasing the changes in Hong Kong's urban culture and human relationships before and after its return to China.
title: See Her Again

overview: In Huanxi City, Fang Haowen's pen is the cheapest weapon there is. It cannot produce bestsellers, yet it can cut through the absurdity of reality. Recognized by businesswoman Jin Furong, he rises to fame overnight, only to crash back down after turning down her love. A drunken fall from a building and a staged "suicide" farce push him into the eye of the internet storm, as his former agent eggs him on to "trade death for sales" and regain viral fame. Then obsessive fan Bie Fan shows up and wrecks the whole carefully scripted livestream scam. That's how the "Jiong Tu" duo comes to be: a has-been writer and his delusional young fan launching into a wild, can't-live-can't-die escapade.
title: See You Later... Maybe

overview: A detective, police superintendent, and psychologist team up to stop a secret assassin network targeting victims based on the New Seven Deadly Sins. As the case deepens, each of them is forced to confront buried secrets, leading to a race against time to stop the next execution.
title: D.I.D. 12

overview: The story follows the decisive and cunning young master Mu Qingyan and the laid-back, free-spirited heroine Cai Zhao, whose intense relationship oscillates between sweetness and anguish. Together, they navigate the treacherous martial world, exposing the "masks" worn by its inhabitants. Their journey is filled with love, hate, constant twists, and strategic battles, painting a vivid picture of a heroic and dynamic martial arts community.
title: Generation to Generation

overview: A casual name. A stolen name. A name that was never hers. A name she dared not speak again. A name never forgotten. Ren Xiaoming had always despised her name, yet no matter how much she loathed it, it was proof of her existence in this world—the very premise of her identity. She would reclaim the name that had been stolen from her. This name did not belong to her alone, but to many others as well. Those invisible names, lost in the mundane routines of daily life, drowned in the whispers of judgment, buried in the endless passage of time—stripped of their identities. Yet someone always remembers them, and someone always follows in their footsteps, until their names are seen by all. A story of struggle and redemption across two generations of women.
title: Vanished Name

overview: A grisly dismemberment case unites two cops with clashing styles, Xu Xiao and Lin Guoqiang, forging a mentor-mentee bond. They uncover a sinister link between the case and an ancient evil ritual for immortality, orchestrated by a seemingly harmless, highly educated young woman.
title: Hanging Mirrors

overview: Charlie Hustle & the Matter of Pete Rose chronicles the life and career of Pete Rose, baseball's all-time hits leader, who received a lifetime ban from the game after a Major League Baseball investigation revealed he bet on the Cincinnati Reds to win games during his time as manager of the team. Charlie Hustle & the Matter of Pete Rose provides intimate access to the polarizing former player as he embarks on a new bid for reinstatement in the MLB and a place in the National Baseball Hall of Fame.
title: Charlie Hustle & the Matter of Pete Rose

overview: In Einstein brilliant but directionless, the great grandson of Albert Einstein spends his days as a comfortably tenured professor until his bad boy antics land him in trouble with the law and he is pressed into service helping a local police detective solve her most puzzling cases.
title: Einstein

overview: La sèrie documental sobre el crim de Tor: Carles Porta reviu la llegenda de la muntanya maleïda.
title: Tor

overview: The deputy commissioner Vanina Guarrasi, after a brilliant career in the anti-mafia, left Palermo in an attempt to escape the past and the bond with the two men she loved most: her policeman father and her ex-boyfriend Paolo Malfitano, a magistrate operating in the anti-mafia. The crazy fear of reliving certain traumas has taken over: and so here is Vanina in Catania, in the new role in the Homicide Section, supported by the esteem of a new team of policemen. And by the affection of her friends.
title: Vanina - Un vicequestore a Catania

overview: Pedro and Astro-Mano are separated by a galaxy. Pedro leads a monotonous and meaningless life and Astro-Mano lives on a planet where his value is not recognized. Pedro is fired from his job and Astro Mano, by accident, crashes to Earth. Their meeting gives rise to an unlikely friendship that will change both their lives. Astro-Mano wants to help Pedro find meaning in his life and Pedro wants to help him return home, but there is someone who will do everything to prevent this from happening. And only the two of them, together, can defeat him. A journey sharing two worlds where the adventures that await them will make them discover their own value. Life is a journey, join us.
title: Astro-Mano

overview: Märchenperlen is ZDF's series of fairy tale adaptations, which has existed since 2005. These are often fairy tales by the Brothers Grimm, which are mainly broadcast in the Christmas program. The films are based on the classic traditions, but have been modernized in terms of narrative and content (e.g. Little Red Riding Hood). Outdated statements and symbolism from the original version were reinterpreted or supplemented in order to take contemporary linguistic sensitivity into account.
title: Märchenperlen

overview: The head of the pre-trial detention center was killed. Fyodor Sechenov is assigned to investigate the crime. Trying to understand who could have killed his friend, the investigator is faced with negativity from employees and prisoners. At the same time, a valuable archive disappears from prison. Gradually, Fedor realizes that a real person is involved in the mysterious events, who has subjugated the entire detention center. Will he be able to find the puppet master before the next murder occurs?
title: Острог. Дело Федора Сеченова

overview: At JU Construction Company, notorious for countless corruption cases, the audit team is busy at work. The team comprises a polar opposite duo: a cold team leader and a generous Gen Z employee. Together, they navigate through turbulent teamwork at first. Yet, as they collectively tackle diverse cases, they harmonize into an unstoppable investigative pair.
title: The Auditors

overview: Set in the German capital Berlin, the series centers around a German woman and single mother of a teenage daughter, who starts a relationship and decides to live together with a widowed Turkish father and his two teenage children.
title: Türkisch für Anfänger

overview: An intimate look at this in-patient psych unit that treats young adults who struggle with mental health disorders.
title: One South: Portrait of a Psych Unit

overview: Three sisters, Ira, Olya and Masha, have long dreamed of leaving Nizhny Novgorod for Moscow. Each sister has her own moving scenario, but they all secretly rely on the financial help of her mother, the owner of Tatiana's jewelry business. However, Tatiana has other plans for life: as a souvenir from her vacation, she brings a massage therapist 20 years younger than herself. And while the whole town is gossiping about a sudden romance, the daughters suspect that the new family member is an ordinary conman. They intend to open Tatiana's eyes to the truth, but does a woman who just wants to be happy need her?
title: Три сестры

overview: Keeping a Family Together When the Country Is Falling Apart. A Crime Saga at the Turn of the Epochs
title: Дети перемен

overview: East Harbour Heroes is a saltwater-soaked journey to St. John's, N.L., where a vibrant community of tough individuals battle the rugged coast and the North Atlantic Ocean to live and work on the edge of the world. From brutal storms, high winds, and changing fish populations, each day brings a new challenge to commercial fishers, stevedores, crane operators, welders, and tugboat operators, and these warriors are determined to thrive – no matter what Mother Nature throws at them.
title: East Harbour Heroes
